title: Several posts from one author compete with each other
dek: Author diversity is on in the defaults, with a decay and a floor.
whatChanged: Author diversity is on by default, with a decay of 0.5 and a floor of 0.25. The multiplier in the scoring code is (1 - floor) times decay raised to an exponent, plus the floor, so a score shrinks toward the floor but never drops below it. These are defaults in the public repo, and live settings can differ.
meaningForCreators: Posts from one author can compete with each other in the same feed load. Spacing out a burst of posts, and letting the best one lead, is the safer plan in these defaults.
action: Do this: space out a burst of posts, and let the strongest one go first.
todos: Confirm which exponent is passed to diversity_multiplier for each post position before adding per-position percentages.
Confirm the EnableAuthorDiversity default (param.rs line 203 in vm-ranker/params.rs) before the on-by-default claim ships.
Hidden from the feed until these checks are done.
